articles.title: Scientists Find a Tiny New Tiger Cat
articles.summary: Scientists have named Leopardus tilcayo, a tiny spotted cat from Bolivia — the first new living cat species described in more than 100 years.

articles.title: A Galaxy Telescope Finds a Brand-New Comet
articles.summary: The Euclid space telescope, built to photograph distant galaxies, has discovered its first comet: C/2026 S1 (Euclid).

articles.title: The Electric Seaglider That Flies on Air
articles.summary: Regent Craft's electric seaglider floats, rises on hydrofoils, and flies just above the waves at up to 180 miles per hour.
